tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Catalan._as_mpf_val computes catalan_fixed at prec+10, converts that integer with exponent -prec-10, then normalizes to prec (sympy/core/numbers.py:4051-4055). These extra bits serve as a precision margin before final normalization, but the comment explicitly says to track down why the increase is necessary. The exact reason and choice of ten are not documented here, so a specific empirical or rounding-error explanation should remain a hypothesis.
